prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Hôpital in the B19_hopital building, outdoors. Camera: on the forecourt in front of the hospital, facing north.
Setting: long three-storey pale primrose-yellow stone hospital with white window frames, a round heart-shaped window in the central gable, a glass entrance canopy, a roof terrace with flower boxes; floor: smooth pale paving with a painted ambulance bay on the left. Landmark: the heart-shaped round gable window and the glass entrance canopy. Light: same spring late-morning daylight as the square. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the glazed sliding doors under the canopy, CENTRE (way to Le hall des urgences); the paved foreground at the bottom left (the way back out).
Also paint a tree-lined avenue running off to the RIGHT of the hospital (a street mouth).
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
prompt_note: 'prompt' is the generation record; the setting text above describes the painting as installed (round oculus, green-glass porch; no heart-shaped window).
